entities.summary: Mark McNeill is a Canadian ice hockey forward who is currently a free agent. He last played for Selber Wölfe of the DEL2. He was selected 18th overall by the Chicago Blackhawks in the 2011, and by Vityaz Chekhov in the fifth round of the 2011 KHL Junior Draft.
